Control panel

Void Engineers

You've just bolted your outpost together at the edge of a claimed asteroid field. You have one battered mining ship, the mineral rights to every rock in sight, and a 170,000,000 credit loan. Mine it, refine it, sell it, and pay it back.

Turn your phone sideways for the full control layout.

First shift

  1. 1The rocks out there are uncharted. Take out the Detector and fly close to one: it gets a name, a type and a waypoint.
  2. 2Drill ore by hand, then board the PIONEER on your landing pad and mine with the ship. Dig deep: some rocks hide buried deposits.
  3. 3Dock at the OUTPOST, move the ore into storage and refine it into ingots. Build more storage, power, lights, even new ships.
  4. 4Build a Trade Beacon. Freight traders buy your goods, and every sale goes toward the loan.

Controls

W A S Dmove / thrust
SpaceCup / down (jump in gravity)
Mouselook (click to capture)
QEroll
LMBuse current tool
TBnext tool: drill, torch, cutter, detector
RMBquick cut (70% refund)
Kcontrol panel for machines
Tabchoose block (torch)
UGgrid panel (rename, upgrades) / dock
Wheelnext tool, or block with torch
Xrotate block facing
Fenter / leave cockpit
Zinertial dampers
Vthird person (in ship)
Rmelt ice into hydrogen
Llamp
Shiftboost on foot
HMthis menu / mute
Arrowslook if mouse capture fails
Left padmove / thrust
Drag screenlook
TOOLnext tool: drill, torch, cutter, detector
ACTuse the current tool
Block tiletorch only: tap the tile to choose a block (station blocks need a gravity field)
TERMProduction and Trade tabs: load goods into Cargo Containers, a Trade Beacon calls freight traders, pay down the loan
GRIDthe ship or station you are on: rename it and upgrade its parts (hold an item to see what the upgrade does)
USEenter / leave cockpit
ROTrotate block facing
SPINslopes and corners: turn the shape a quarter turn around its facing
DOCKwhile flying: appears near a Landing Pad (12 m) or with the legs within a block of a flat station panel; snaps you down and locks. UNDOCK to lift off
FUELmelt ice into hydrogen
